references.text: The same principle of helping your enemy's donkey that has gone astray, and leading it back to him.
The immediate context establishing the duty to care for lost animals and return them to their owner.
A similar command to help your enemy's donkey that is lying under its burden.
The fundamental command to love your neighbor as yourself, which is the ethical basis for returning lost property.
Jesus' golden rule of doing to others what you would have them do to you, which includes the principle of returning lost property.
Luke's version of the golden rule expressing the same principle of caring for others' property.
